cases.name: surface
cases.when: `interactive` is false -- the default, and nothing obliges a consumer to change it
cases.reason: Card renders a bordered surface with an optional eyebrow/title header and an `action` slot; it manages no state, adds no role, and owns no interactive element of its own -- any button or control inside comes from `children` or `action`, both caller-supplied content, not from Card itself. This is the shape that keeps a dead tab stop off every card of every list.

cases.name: interactive
cases.when: `interactive` is true -- the whole card is one activation target, the ordinary shape of a list on a phone
